accentstrip.description: enables the pixel accents (sequencer). Also defined as an offset on either the main blade & strip output LS1 (> 0), or LS2 (< 0).

ack.description: to enable/disable double line feed ( ) as acknowledge of a successful serial command

auto-dim.description: Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms. A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected. Example setting: 360000,30

auto-off.description: Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms. A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected. Example setting: 8000,5

auto-on.description: Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms. A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected. Example setting: 5000,10

auto-shutoff.description: Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms. A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected. Example setting: 120000

auxaccentstrip.description: enables the pixel accents (sequencer). Also defined as an offset on either the main blade & strip output LS1 (> 0), or LS2 (< 0).

auxstrip.description: defines the number of pixels of the secondary blade, rendered on the ledstrip output

bank.description: Force a specific sound bank at startup (overrides prefs.txt) for a character saber

beep.description: Sets the volume of the user interface (UI) sounds and the system beeps.

bladecharge.description: enable any of the power drivers (L1- to L4-) that are used by strip power so that the blade charge can go thru the board and charge the battery without any add-on board. If live wire option is used, browsing the OLED or accessing blade PLI will revive the drivers and will allow for charging too even if live wire prevents the powering of the drivers in other conditions

values.0: Normal blade - no sound interaction (normal blade during iSaber)
values.1: FoC color blending - FoC color blending with the blade (all over the blade) based on the audio
values.2: FoC color progressive overlay - FoC color progressive overlay above the blade (bi-color bargraph)
values.4: FoC to Blade gradient - FoC color (bottom) to blade color (top) gradient bargraph

blademusicstyle.description: When in ledstrip mode, iSaber will use the blade as a visual renderer of the sound when the saber is on

bladeplicolor.description: "specifies the PLI color either with the 4 channel list or the color dictionary. Example: bladeplicolor=Crimson)

bladeplisize.description: specifiesthe number of pixel on which to display the PLI. Maxvalue is actually the blade length

values.2: Gradient from white (top) to defined color (bottom)

bladeplistyle.description: display a PLI over the blade if no OLED is attached (and in ledstrip mode)

bladepower.description: Control over the blade power in %. Allows for reducing the power bill without touching the colors themselves

blastm.description: Enables Blaster Move. Blaster Move allows the ability to trigger a sequence of blaster sounds with the motion of the hilt. Only the first sound is triggered by a short press on the aux. switch, then further swing-like gestures will trigger more blaster sounds, until a blaster sound ends, or if a clash interrupts the sequences (assuming blastp=0).

blastp.description: defines if the blaster priority is enabled or not. This decides if a clash can interrupt the blaster blocking sounds. Swings are always disabled during blasters. With the blaster priority on, the sound of the blaster must finish first then a swing might be executed. This allows a nice choreography for blocking blaster rays using a long blaster file without getting the sound stopped by a swing. If the choreography has stressed movements that might trigger a clash, set the parameter to 1 so that no gestural events can interrupt the blaster sequence. Conversely, if you wish a blaster sequence to be possibly interrupted by a clash, disable the parameter

bolt<n>.description: for a blaster2.wav sound featuring 4 impacts. Each number indicates the number of milliseconds from the beginning of the sound file before triggering a bolt impact. bolt1=487,1297,1921

buttx.description: defines the offset from the right side of the screen where the PLI scale (bars) stops

clash_flow.description: swing rate flow limiter. Delay during which clashes cannot be furthermore triggered.

cname.description: A nice name for the colorprofile

dbolt.description: min and max of Bolt duration

debug.description: enables the board debug which outputs extensive logs of the board activity such as configuration files parsing, sounds selected and played or file lookup. Debug should be enabled only when troubleshooting the board as the very verbose log will slow down the boot time. Also, it is recommended to turn debug off when configuring the board with RICE to avoid a verbose echo from the board to the computer each time a parameter is changed.

deep.description: defines the time after which the sound board will move into deep sleep mode for saving power (<0.25 mA). Same as above. The deep sleep counter starts after the sleep mode has engaged. Sleep and Deep Sleep durations are cumulative.

delay_sbright.description: Determines the speed of the cooldown of the swingbright effect

depth_flicker.description: : defines the spatial flicker mixing depth with flicker color

dragstrip.description: defines the maximum size (pixels) of the drag tip effect

drift.description: defines if the instability contaminates over the blade. Used for unstable and rain sizzle, set to 1 automatically for the fire fx

fade.description: color profile transition time. Must be lower than the color.wav sound duration

fbolt.description: bolt impact energy distribution and edge fading / blending (in %). 100% will generate a solid flash all over the picked up size. 1% will have the center of the impact at the maximum brightness which will fade progressively down to 1% as you move to the edges of the impact.

field.description: Reference magnetic field for the Magic Activation and SaberLock. List of 3 numbers defining the neutral field. See the dedicated section related to those features further in the manual

flkd.description: depth (in %) of the energy fluctuation effect, i.e. the the range over which the LED brightness will be affected during the effect. A low value does not modify the energy very much while a high value digs big gaps of light intensity. To be used with the parameter flks. Set to 0 to obtain a static blade.

flks.description: A high value produces a damaged saber effect while a small value generates subtile energy changes. The value 0 disables the effect (static blade). Keep above 4 when using a ledstrip blade to avoid competing with the pixels (inherent) refresh rate.

foc%.description: Flash on Clash effect depth. Defines how deep the FoC brightness is dug for on-top (or non-mixed) FoC di(c)e.

focb.description: defines if the Flash on Clash is enabled during Blaster Blocking effect

focf1.description: defines if the Flash on Clash is enabled during Force effect

focf2.description: defines if the Flash on Clash is enabled during Force Clash effect

focf3.description: defines if the Flash on Clash is enabled during StabFx effect

focl.description: defines if the Flash on Clash is enabled during Blade Lockup effect

focp.description: periodicity of the light bursts during the Flash on Clash effect. A low period will produce tight bursts.

focr.description: random value applied to the periodicity of the light burst during a Flash on Clash effect. Similar to shmrr but applied to FoC

fontgest.description: Enables loading the next font by pressing the activator and clashing the blade. If set to 0, while in single switch mode (switch=3) and using a ledstrip blade, that same action will toggle the blade PLI on/off

force_flicker.description: defines the spatial flicker intensity and randomness

gate.description: minimum motion quantity required to start the motion recognition engine.Base value between 15 to 70 works fine (default: 50)

glyph.description: defines the accent LEDs pattern to be displayed when browsing the font from the menu. LED 1 to LED 8 left-to-right ordered, a 1 turns the corresponding LED on.

hcool.description: defines how to temper the instability. Low values make the blade return quicker to its stable while high values will make the blade overall more unstable / active.

hdrag.description: drag threshold followed by the angular range

hfclash.description: threshold to trigger a force clash fx

hhybrid.description: Hybrid or accent swing threshold when using a smoothswing font

hstab.description: stab threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the stab effect can be executed

htemp.description: the temperature threshold. (not a gesture/motion parameter but hosted with the other thresholds)

hum_delay.description: (beta) Changes the crossfade mixing point of the hum during the ignition sequence. Defined in % of the duration of the (selected) power-on sound. 0% makes the hum starting to ramp from the beginning of the ignition sound. Getting close to 100% will make the ramping coarser obviously, even if computed on a sample-based timeline. To be used rather with POI = 0 or 1 for smooth swing fonts otherwise, motion to sound smoothswing will take over the hum vs. pairs dynamic mixing which will have very little sense with the point the hum delay tries to achieve.

hum_gain.description: (beta) specific mixing parameter for the hum sound. Leave to 100 (%) for now

ignd.description: Delays the ignition scrolling or power-on fx process. Set qon so that the expected fx duration (scrolling) is qon – ignd. For example, if you want the blade to scroll out in 400 ms with a delay of 200 ms after the beginning of the power-on sound, set qon = 600 and ignd = 200.

lbolt.description: impact location restriction on the blade. In the example above, {15,30} forces the bolt to be at 15 pixel minimum from the bottom of the blade and 30 pixels away from the top of the blade.

lcool.description: defines how to temper the instability. Low values make the blade return quicker to its stable while high values will make the blade overall more unstable / active.

ledstrip.description: enables the ledstrip support by defining the number of pixel of the main blade. 0 leaves the board in high-power LED mode. The number of pixels accounts for just one ledstrip: a blade composed of two strips of 120 pixels back to back is defined as 120 pixels

values.2: after sleep - disable (led)strip power after after sleep

livewire.description: Live Wire options : disable (led)strip power after

lockup.description: our module features an auxiliary switch to trigger additional sound/visual effects. A short pressure on the switch generates the blaster effect (the saber blade stops a blaster ray), plays one of the blaster sounds. A longer pressure (maintained) triggers a blade lockup effect: while the switch is pressed, the sound lockup.wav is played in loop with some shimmering applied to the high-power LED. The parameter lockup specifies the duration of the delay before triggering the lockup effect. A short value (100 to 200) will trigger the effect almost immediately: to trigger a blaster effect, the user will have to release the button quickly. Conversely, a higher value will leave more time to produce a blaster blocking feature

values.0: USB - Log data is only sent to USB port
values.1: TTL - Log data is only sent to TTL (legacy RICE) serial port
values.2: USB and TTL - Log data is sent to both USB and TTL
values.3: WebUSB - Log data is sent to WebUSB

logport.description: defines where the debug / logged information is sent. 0 is the USB serial port, 1 is the TTL (legacy RICE) serial port, 2 sends to both. Set to 1 or 2 if you want to use the legacy RICE or a Bluetooth module.

logttl.description: Serial communication sent to RX (like from a bluetooth module) can be monitored via USB serial connection

loop.description: iSaber (audio player) parameter defining if the current track plays endlessly or if it the player will fetch another track once it ends.

magic.description: if enabled with a non-zero value, defines the magnetic threshold to activate the saber

mapb.description: define what % of the instability will affect the blade color (dim). A high value will dig more in the blade color and will create darker spots.

mapc.description: define what % of the instability will bring up the FoC color where the instability is. High value will produce bright FoC colored spots.

mapping_audio.description: range used for mapping audio to the fx (like flicker). A low value means the effect will be quickly visible on audio change. High value means it will be less and later visible during audio change

mapping_color.description: defines the fx color map (legacy vs. heat mapping)

values.2: Angular controlled

mapping_drag.description: defines the dynamic behavior of the drag fx

values.2: Angular controlled

mapping_flicker.description: defines the dynamic behavior of the Flicker fx

values.2: Angular controlled

mapping_lockup.description: defines the dynamic behavior of the lockup fx

mapping_move.description: range used for mapping movement to the fx (like swingbright). A low value means the effect will be quickly visible when swinging. High value means it will be less and later visible during swinging

values.2: Angular controlled

mapping_sbright.description: defines the dynamic behavior of the swingbright fx

values.2: Angular controlled

mapping_unstable.description: defines the dynamic behavior of the unstable fx

masterpower.description: Master control over the blade power in %. Allows for reducing the power bill without touching the colors themselves

maxvol.description: Sets the maximum volume that the soundboard will output

mcolor.description: Flash on Clash mixing configuration. Color profiles also embed a per color profile FoC Mixing parameter with mcolor. This ensures to get the best / adapted Flash on Clash mixing strategy for any color defined by the profile. Refer to the dedicated Flash on Clash mixing paragraph.

menugest.description: Enables the use of saber motions to browse or select options while in the vocal menu: twist the hilt left/right moves to the previous/next bank and a bang will validate the currently selected font.

menuvol.description: digital volume of the vocal menu.

values.0: disabled - option is disabled (volume is defined by the vol parameter)
values.1: Boot sound - the orientation will control only the boot sound volume. The volume of the saber is further defined by the normal volume parameter (vol in the config.txt file).
values.2: Boot and regular sound - the orientation during power up controls both the volume of the boot sound and further use of the saber.
values.3: Boot and ignitions - the orientation during power controls the volume of the boot sound. Orientation will then also control separately each activation of the saber. This allows, among various possibilities, to squeeze boot sound while maintaining some sound volume of the saber.

muteb.description: Enables the mute-on-the-boot feature which controls the volume of the boot sound with the angle of the hilt. If enabled, this feature also controls the menu volume. See the specific paragraph dedicated to this feature for more details.

muteoff.description: Defines if the power-off sound will be played when the saber has Mute-onthe-Go engaged

off_fade.description: enables the progressive fade out effect (combined with the ledstrip scrolling effect, this is the ScrollFade feature). Applies to both HB leds and ledstrip blades. With off_fade, those are part of the blade profiles.

offd.description: power-off delay. An alternative to A-POP defining how long the user must press the activation switch before the blade goes off. Values from 100 to 500 ms are relevant and very efficient for just ensuring the saber won't be turned off accidentally. Set to zero if you use an anti-power off protection with parameter offp

offp.description: To avoid accidentally powering off the saber, especially when using a momentary button for activation, we added a power off protection. When this parameter is set to 1, the user must press the activation button and confirm with the auxiliary button. It is not necessary to press both buttons at the same time, keep the activation switch pressed first, then press the auxiliary switch: the blade goes off.

offsetx.description: defines the offset from the left side of the screen where the PLI scale (bars) starts

oledcustom.description: custom text to display on the OLED along with the firmware version screen (boot time if oledversion is enabled, and idle time). About 20 characters maximum.

oledflip.description: rotates the display 180 to adapt to the wiring or orientation in the hilt. 0 (or commented) is the regular orientation with the text being read normally with the screen wiring pads on the left side. 1 flips the orientation 180.

values.2: Version - Shows firmware version

oledland.description: Oled landing page after booting or power off.

oledscreensaver.description: delay after which the screen savers will be triggered on the OLED.

oledstop.description: disables the oled from further use (for testing purpose). When this parameter is present the OLED is disabled

oledversion.description: defines if the firmware version is displayed at boot time (before the boot logo) and for how long (in ms).

omnisabers.description: enables the Omnisabers feature which remotely transmits saber actions to a distant system via the serial port.

omnisense.description: beaconing period of Omnisabers, in ms. Used when Omnisabers is enabled. 0 disables beaconing. Beaconing will prevent the board from entering deep sleep in most cases as it keeps the board active (expected when using Omnisabers).

on_fade.description: enables the progressive fade in effect (combined with the ledstrip scrolling effect, this is the ScrollFade feature). Applies to both HB leds and ledstrip blades. With off_fade, those are part of the blade profiles.

ond.description: This parameter is also used as a time base for the double click event. Value of 20 to 50ms are relevant

onp.description: If the parameter is set to 1, you must press the aux. button after pressing / cycling the activation switch in order to ignite the blade

values.0: Top -Front orientation - saber pointing that way =====>>>>>> USB to the left, CFX logo on top
values.1: Top-Rear orientation - saber pointing that way =====>>>>>> USB to the right, CFX logo on top
values.2: Bottom-Front orientation - saber pointing that way =====>>>>>> sd-card reader to the left, CFX logo on bottom
values.3: Bottom-Rear orientation - saber pointing that way =====>>>>>> sd-card reader to the left, CFX logo on top

orient.description: defines the board plane orientation in the hilt

values.2: BlendFX
values.4: GraFx Xfade - Cross-fades the GraFx animation with the blade fx

values.2: BlendFX
values.4: GraFx Xfade - Cross-fades the GraFx animation with the blade fx

plilh.description: Power level indicator range in millivolts. Low and high boundaries of the PLI defining a depleted / fully charged battery. For a single li-ion cell, values likes 3400,4200 are common.

pname.description: Gives the option to name your blade profiles!

pof.description: Power on Force threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the Power on Force effect can be executed. enables the Power on Force saber ignition technique (see paragraph 'Motion activated ignition' for more detail). The parameter defines the motion threshold required to ignite the blade with a motion faking the use of the 'Force' to activate the saber. 350-500 works usually fine.

values.0: Interrupt disabled - Action-sounds will start after power-on sound has completed
values.1: Quick-on intterupt - Action-sounds will start after quick-on ignition has timed out
values.2: Interrupt enabled - Action sounds on ignition start

poi.description: power-on interrupt. When enabled, a sound fx (clash, swing, smoothswing) can interrupt the power-on sound before the ignition sequence is over. 0 disables power-on sound interruption, motion sounds and smoothswing (if enabled) will start once the power-on sound is over. With poi=1, motion is enabled once quick-on ignition has timed out (qon, per-font parameter, in font_config.txt). With poi=2, motion is enabled when ignition starts.

values.0: By angle - board will use current angle of the hilt to choose the power on sound played when saber is ignited by a motion.
values.1: By angle with Force - Same as 'By angle', but with the poweronf(orce) special sound played when initiating a force triggered (vertical shake) ignition (aka PoF)
values.2: Random with Force - random power on + special PoF sound.

pom.description: When set to 0, board will use current angle of the hilt to choose the power on sound played when saber is ignited by a motion; mode 1 as well but with the poweronf(orce) special sound played when initiating a force triggered (vertical shake) ignition (aka PoF). Mode 2 is random power on + special PoF sound, mode 3 is random at all times.

pos_flicker.description: defines the spatial flicker location on the blade

powerfail.description: Powers the saber back on after a short powerloss

pulsed.description: Pulse effect depth in %. 100% will dig the full range of the high power LED from max brightness to off.

pulsel.description: Pulse effect length (duration). Defines the ramp up/down time.

qbolt.description: Bolt impact speed (in %). Combined with the duration parameter (and bolt size range) it defines how fast it will travel on the blade when using certain blaster bolt styles (like wave). A ballpark is to see 100% speed as ensuring the bolt energy is sure to travel the whole blade during the bolt duration.

qkignite.description: enables igniting the blade right after waking up from deep sleep. The saber will boot normally but will skip the boot sound and will power the blade up

qoff.description: Allows having the blade retracted in a specific amount of time rather than matching the duration of the power off sound and should not exceed the duration of any power on sounds. Almost mandatory for ledstrip blade to have a visually satisfying scrolling retraction.

qon.description: Allows having the blade ignited in a specific amount of time rather than matching the duration of the power on sound and should not exceed the duration of any power on sounds. Almost mandatory for ledstrip blade to have a visually satisfying scrolling ignition.

quickmenu-accents.description: enable or disable the top-level menu for adjusting the accents (0 = mennu disabled, 1 = enabled)

quickmenu-pixies.description: enable or disable the top-level menu for adjusting the pixies (0 = mennu disabled, 1 = enabled)

values.0: Random play - the sound is randomly chosen in the available slots.
values.1: In sequence - the sound is played in sequence. (slot 1, then 2 etc.)
values.2: No recurring - the sound is randomly chosen without triggering the same sound twice in a row.

randb.description: set the selection mode for picking the Blaster blocking sounds.

randc.description: Brings some color variance to FoC. Applies also to blaster in HB led mode (ledstrip blasters bolts have their own specific color parameters in ledstrip mode)

values.0: Random play - the sound is randomly chosen in the available slots.
values.1: In sequence - the sound is played in sequence. (slot 1, then 2 etc.)
values.2: No recurring - the sound is randomly chosen without triggering the same sound twice in a row.

random.description: set the selection mode for picking the clash, swing, spin and stab sounds.

range-accents.description: define a lower and upper limit for the accentstrip parameter

range-pixies.description: define a lower and upper limit for the pixies parameter

rbolt.description: Bolt impact color randomization (in %). Provides some variance on the bolt color from impact to impact. Affect separately each RGB component in order to really alter the hue and not just brightness.

refreshfx.description: defines in ms the refresh rate (and computation) of the ledstrip fx. It's supposed to be equal or greater to the flicker speed. Higher values (as a period) lead to slower refresh rate and can be used for slow effects like fire.

retd.description: Delays the retraction scrolling or power-on fx process.

values.0: Disabled - If there's 'magic' threshold defined, magic activation is enabled
values.1: Magic activation - Without the 'magic' threshold being met, activation is denied
values.2: Magic retraction - Without the 'magic' threshold being met, retraction is denied
values.3: Magic activation and retraction - Without the 'magic' threshold being met, activation and retraction are denied

saberlock.description: Activation control of the saber using a magnetic field such as a magnetic ring. Prevent activation (or retraction) when magnetic values are not met.

sbolt.description: list of 2 numbers, minimum and maximum size of the bolt impact. When set to 0,0 and in ledstrip mode, the bolt will make the whole blade to flash (legacy Flash on Clash)

shmr%.description: Defines how the shimmer will "dig" the defined blade brightness during a clash or a lockup effect. A static flash is achieved by leaving that value to 0. That parameter is actually composed of 2 numbers separated by a comma to define the range to apply to the brightness modification during the shimmer.

shmrd.description: duration of the shimmering effect of the high-power LED during a clash. Make sure this duration is not too much longer than the associated sound to keep a nice result.

shmrp.description: periodicity of the light bursts during the clash effect. A slow period will produce tight bursts.

shmrr.description: random value applied to the periodicity of the light burst during a clash effect. Allows having bursts that are not regularly spaced in time which increases the realism. For instance, a period shmrp of 20 and a random value shmrr of 10 will produce a period between two bursts varying between 20 and 30ms.

values.0: Random play - the sound is randomly chosen in the available slots.
values.1: In sequence - the sound is played in sequence. (slot 1, then 2 etc.)
values.2: No recurring - the sound is randomly chosen without triggering the same sound twice in a row.

shuffle.description: iSaber (audio player) track random selection parameter (refer to sound selection modes for more details)

simplemenu.description: Simplified Vocal menu (no system / games / USB)

skip.description: skips the font in the vocal menu. Allows for having a large amount of font available on the SD card while reducing the selection in the menu (manual setting)

values.0: Disabled - If the board is in deep sleep mode the board can only be awoken by the blade ignition (activator) switch.
values.1: Skip all - skip all boot info
values.2: Skip during tangible - skip boot during tangible font change

skipboot.description: define whether or not to display font.bmp (and play sound) during tangible font change using a crystal or a chassis accessory

sleep.description: defines the time after which the sound board will move into sleep mode, turning the idle accent sequence off and saving some current. Parameter expressed in multiple of 1ms; 300,000 equates 300 seconds or 5 minutes. 0 to disable.

smooth_dampen.description: defines the hum dampening (%) when the smoothswing pair is played. 75% means that the hum volume is reduced of 75%

smooth_flow.description: smoothswing rate flow limiter. Delay during which a smoothswing pair change cannot be furthermore triggered.

smooth_gain.description: defines the volume of the smoothswing effect

smooth_gate.description: minimum required to start the smoothswing engine. Usually thesame as the gate above but we added a specific parameter to it, just in case

values.2: Hybrid: accent swing

smooth_mode.description: smoothswing mode. 0 disables the smoothswing engine for a smoothswing font. 1 is the standard smoothswing mode, 2 is the hybrid font (aka accent swing) mode for which regular swing and spins can be played if the motion exceeds the hswing threshold3 . Mode 3 uses the blade orientation to control the mix between the hum pairs and the main hum to pseudo-replicate the former CF pitch shifting effect

smooth_physics.description: motion milestone threshold to tell the smoothswing engine to change of pair. A high threshold tends to keep the current pair; a low value will produce more pair picking.

smooth_sens.description: smoothswing overall sensitivity to blade rotation (in /s). A low value will bring the smoothswing effect to its maximum volume with a small motion. A large value will require faster rotations to bring the volume to the maximum. Works with the sharpness parameter above

smooth_sharp.description: brings softness (< 1.0) or sharpness (> 1.0) to the mapping between the blade rotation and the smoothswing expressivity. A value of 1.5 adds a bit of exponential mapping (small blade moves are amplified). Values > 1.0 make the smoothswing engine more expressive even with small motions

smooth_width1.description: angular regions () in which the high and low pairs transition and cross fade to produce the pitch effect. The first region is usually set to a low(er) value to start producing a pitch offset early with the beginning of the motion, while the second transition occurs close to a half spin (180).

smooth_width2.description: angular regions () in which the high and low pairs transition and cross fade to produce the pitch effect. The first region is usually set to a low(er) value to start producing a pitch offset early with the beginning of the motion, while the second transition occurs close to a half spin (180).

sparkd.description: defines the instability spreading on the blade (0-100% of the blade length).

spectrum_axis.description: Spectrum (color profile selection) axis. 0 is pitch (up/down), 1 is roll (throttle).

values.2: Aux+Twist

values.0: AA: Legacy browsing P+ || AT = Legacy browsing P+/-
values.2: AA = Legacy browsing || AT = Spectrum dial
values.3: AA = Spectrum dial || AT = Legacy browsing P+/-
values.4: AA = Legacy browsing P+ || AT = Kyber dial + Profiles
values.5: AA = Kyber dial + Profiles || AT Legacy Browsing P+
values.7: AA = Blade Profile Browsing B+ || AT = Legacy Browsing P+/-
values.8: AA = Legacy Browsing P+ || AT = Blade Profile Browsing B+/-
values.9: AA = Spectrum Dial || AT = Kyber Dial + Profiles
values.10: AA = Kyber Dial + Profiles || AT = Spectrum Dial

spectrum_mode.description: Spectrum (color profile selection) mode. P = navigating color profile. B = navigating blade profile. AA = Aux. + Act || AT = Aux + Twist

spin_flow.description: spin rate flow limiter. Delay during which spins cannot be furthermore triggered.

start_blade.description: defines a specific blade profile to start with when this specific font is selected. Overrides the last used profile saved in prefs.txt. -1 disables the feature and let the stored value from prefs.txt be used at boot time.

start_color.description: defines a specific color profile to start with when this specific font is selected. Overrides the last used profile saved in prefs.txt. -1 disables the feature and let the stored value from prefs.txt be used at boot time.

strippower.description: defines which channels {#1;#4} are used to control ledstrip power or leave them mirror the blade color. Since version 10.002 of the firmware, the general configuration uses parameter strippower (bitfield) to control which of the L- driver outputs are used for powering the ledstrip and which are still mirroring the blade color channels. For instance: strippower=1110 will configure channels #1, #2 and #3 as strip (negative) power control while channel #4 remains free for mirroring the color channel. This comes quite handy when its used to drive a rumbling motor or a spinning crystal chamber. See Ledstrip blade specifics section in the manual

style_accents.description: defines the linking between the profile and the location of the accent led configuration file (leds.txt) within /extra/ACCENTS indexed subfolders
style_accents.notes: Points to an indexed resource subfolder on the SD card - valid values depend on what's actually present there, not a fixed range or option list.

style_auxpixies.description: defines the linking between the profile and the location of the pixel accents configuration file within /extra/PIXIES indexed subfolders

values.1: Legacy impact - flash generated by the blade object
values.2: Fading bolt - fading bolt with adjustable edges (CFX, Prizm & CS legacy)
values.3: Splitting waves - Two energy waves split apart from impact location
values.5: Splitting waves combined with an impact flare
values.6: Splitting waves (with tailing) combined with an impact flare
values.7: Energy - with a gradient of energy spreadin
values.8: Expandable - with a gradient of energy spreading and flaring at the bolt center

values.1: Legacy - Legacy clash all over the blade, bring FoC & Shimmer fx, mirroring the blade color when a HB led clash occurs
values.2: Fade - Fade applies FoC color all over the blade and fades back to blade color over time for the duration of focd parameter
values.3: Local fade - Local fade make it fade as well but creates a localized clash that is changing randomly on the blade.

switch.description: selects if the saber is activated by a normally-open or a normally-closed switch. Other switches might simply have an inverted logic (normally closed contact). When switch is set to 1, the saber lights up when the electrical contact of the switch is closed and conversely when switch is set to 0. We recommend to use a momentary switch for the blade activation, (set switch to 2). Finally, the board also supports single switch with option 3.

tangible.description: Tangible font selection. Use with an external 10k Pullup resistor to 3.3V (main or aux.) and GPIO1 - Now 16 slots. x <-> don't start / X <-> don't start + retraction on removal / o <-> start ok / - <-> neutral / number <-> font to change to addons : r <-> detects removal but won't prevent start / O <-> plays start ok only if previously in another state. Example setting: o,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,X

tetris.description: defines the offset from the right side of the screen where the PLI scale (bars) stops

trackgest.description: Enables the track selection by pressing the activator and twisting the hilt (if the font has local tracks or while in iSaber mode).

tridentflk.description: Trident channels have their flicker computed separately from the main channel(s) in real time, producing the effect that they live on their own and do not totally mirror the main blade behavior. In addition, they can also have their own flicker specified by this parameter, in order to produce a more dramatic flickering effect on the cross-guard.

values.0: Simple delay - the normal (non-Trident) channel starts ramping up followed by the delayed channel(s) which start(s) after the duration specified by the tridenton parameter. All channels catch up together at the end of the power-on sound.
values.1: In sequence - the non-delayed channels will ramp up to their max within the duration of tridenton, then the delayed Trident channels will ramp on their own until the end of the power-on sound.

tridentfx.description: Defines the mode of the Trident effect. Mode 0 is a simple delay, the normal (non-Trident) channel starts ramping up followed by the delayed channel(s) which start(s) after the duration specified by the tridenton parameter. All channels catch up together at the end of the power-on sound. In mode 1, the non-delayed channels will ramp up to their max within the duration of tridenton, then the delayed Trident channels will ramp on their own until the end of the power-on sound. The 2 modes show little differences in behavior if the delay duration is close to the power-on sound duration but are interesting if the delay is < to half of the duration of the power-on sound.

tridentoff.description: Same as tridenton but during the power-off. If zero, there is no Trident effect during the blade retraction and all channels fade out normally.

tridenton.description: Defines the delay of the secondary blades, in the case of a cross-guard saber. Should remain < to the duration of the power on sound.

tridentquick.description: Similar to the quick on and quick off parameters, forces the trident channel(s) ignition time. In multiple of 1ms. If zero, trident channel(s) will keep ramping until the end of the power on sound.

tridentstrip.description: enables the trident support in ledstrip mode. Defines the quillons length and the offset at which the normal/main blade starts. Positive value will establish the quillon on the main ledstrip output LS1, negative on LS2

twoff.description: twistoff threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the twiston effect can be executed

twon.description: twiston threshold followed by angular range (2 values [-90;90]) in which the twiston effect can be executed

values.2: Flame. Our legacy fire

unstable.description: These effects simulate an unstable blade.

used_profiles_blade.description: A 32‑bit bitmask in which each bit corresponds to one of up to 32 blade profiles. A bit value of 1 means “enable” that profile during on‑the‑fly color switching, and 0 means “disable” it.

used_profiles_color.description: A 32‑bit bitmask in which each bit corresponds to one of up to 32 color profiles. A bit value of 1 means “enable” that profile during on‑the‑fly color switching, and 0 means “disable” it.

valsnd.description: enables or disables the repeat of the selected soundbank description sound in the vocal menu (font.wav) after selecting it. When disabled, it saves time in the selection process. Also, when disabled, the aux. switch confirmation process for rebooting the saber is disabled (see rebooting the saber paragraph).

vol.description: digital volume setup. 0 mutes the sound output, 100 is the maximum volume.

values.0: Disabled - If the board is in deep sleep mode the board can only be awoken by the blade ignition (activator) switch.
values.1: Keep awaken - Motion of the hilt will reset the sleep timer. Motion of the hilt will allow the board to leave sleep state.
values.2: Wake on Move - Motion of the hilt will reset the sleep timer. Motion of the hilt will not allow the board to leave sleep state.

wakeup.description: defines if the board can be woken up (leaving sleep mode) by moving the hilt. When parameter is set to 0, and once the board has entered deep sleep mode, board can only be woken up by the blade ignition (activator) switch. When set to 1 or 2, motion of the hilt while the blade is off will reset the sleep timer which maintains the hilt in idle mode, hence playing the accent led sequence matching that mode. However, when parameter is set to 1, motion on the hilt allows the board to leave the sleep state, while being set to 2, motion will not allow the board to leave sleep once that state has been reached.

xcolor.description: The dedicated xcolor part of the color profile defines the crystal chamber color (see the accent sequencer section) profile. Crystal chamber drive values are expressed between 0 and 1023 like the other colors.
